prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1012; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a low-speed collision in the parking lot of a retail location. Insured vehicle reported as struck while reversing. Claimant reports minor neck pain at scene and was advised to seek medical evaluation. Claimant is not represented by counsel. Photos requested from both parties.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant describes neck stiffness and headache beginning the day after the incident. Claimant has since visited an urgent care clinic and has been diagnosed with whiplash. Medical records requested with signed authorization. Claimant confirmed no attorney retained at this time.

Entry 3: Reviewed scene photos and parking lot surveillance footage provided by the property manager. Footage shows both vehicles moving at low speed in a parking aisle with minimal visible damage. Liability appears to lean toward the insured vehicle based on the reversing movement. Liability determination pending final review.

Entry 4: Received medical records from the urgent care provider. Records confirm whiplash diagnosis, prescribed muscle relaxant and physical therapy referral. Claimant advised of the claims process, including how the injury component will be evaluated. Claimant again confirmed they are proceeding without legal representation and was given the claim contact line for questions.

Entry 5: Physical therapy progress notes received showing improving range of motion over the past several weeks. Claimant reports pain has decreased but has not fully resolved. Injury file updated and referred for supervisor review. Follow-up call scheduled to check on treatment status and to confirm receipt of all outstanding documentation.
